item.title: Proton’s Lumo, a privacy-focused alternative to ChatGPT and Claude, arrives on desktop
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Proton's new Lumo Desktop app for Windows, Mac, and Linux lets users automate tasks across files and connected apps, with granular controls over what its AI can access.

item.title: AI models can be tricked into identifying civilians as military targets by telling them it’s a game
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec, Rebecca Bellan
item.description: Vals, a San Francisco-based AI evaluation startup, tested whether leading AI models could be manipulated into participating in autonomous warfare. They usually compiled.

item.title: Jensen Huang says he would be ‘honored’ if allowed to return as Nvidia CEO
item.dc:creator: Russell Brandom
item.description: In the first public statement since his resignation, Nvidia founder Jensen Huang signaled his willingness to return as CEO.

item.title: Daydream’s new AI agent acts as your personal stylist — and can shop for you, too
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Daydream's new AI shopping agent can remember your style, virtually try on clothes, plan outfits around your wardrobe, track sales, and complete purchases.

item.title: Uber and Zipline’s drone delivery service takes off in Texas, with dozens of cities to follow
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: The two companies want to make one million deliveries per day using Zipline drones by the end of 2029.

item.title: Meta launches Direct, a stand-alone messaging app for Instagram
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: Direct is launching in Turkey and Thailand, and can be used with or without an Instagram account.

item.title: Voyage Labs raises $12 million for a specialized AI travel assistant
item.dc:creator: Russell Brandom
item.description: Voyage Labs’ flagship product is called Atlas, meant to work as a personal assistant for your trip-planning, available today in private beta.

item.title: Instagram’s new tool for creators targets unauthorized reposts and AI-modified videos
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: The announcement likely comes in response to creators' concerns over how easily original content can be copied and redistributed across social media platforms, especially considering how generative AI has made it easier to manipulate existing videos.

item.title: Isomorphic Labs raises $5B as it looks to take drug candidates to clinical trials
item.dc:creator: Ram Iyer
item.description: Isomorphic Labs, the AI drug-discovery platform that was spun out of Google’s DeepMind in 2021, has raised $5 billion in a Series C funding round.

item.title: Science Corporation’s brain tech is worth $3.5 billion after new funding
item.dc:creator: Tim Fernholz
item.description: Science Corp. raised a $400 million Series D to scale up its anti-blindness business.

item.title: Nvidia’s first big move after Jensen Huang’s exit targets national security
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: The new standing committee will give board-level oversight of national security policies, export control compliance, and global trade risks, the company said.

item.title: Spotify’s new tool aims to stop deepfakes from being attributed to real artists
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: The update comes as Billboard reported last month that Sony Music had requested the removal of more than 260,000 deepfake songs from digital platforms, nearly double the number the label disclosed in March.

item.title: Genesis AI raises $500M to deploy glove-wearing robots
item.dc:creator: Tim Fernholz
item.description: Genesis AI's novel approach to training dexterous robots earned it $500 million in Series A funding.

item.title: Upside Foods can now make a million pounds of chicken a year without killing any animals
item.dc:creator: Amanda Silberling
item.description: The first ever lab-grown hamburger cost $300,000 to make in 2013. Upside Foods says its cultivated chicken can now match the price range of “really high-quality organic chicken."

item.title: Hank Green is self-funding ClockwiseTV, a curated educational video platform for kids
item.dc:creator: Amanda Silberling
item.description: Alongside CEO Leslie Morgan, Hank Green set out to create the video platform he wished his kid had.

item.title: Cybersecurity AI startup Corma reaches $1B valuation in about 3 months
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: Three months since introducing its product, AI cybersecurity startup Corba has raised a $125 million Series A at a $1 billion valuation led by NEA.

item.title: Cyber giant Infoblox confirms security incident after hackers access ‘company information’
item.dc:creator: Zack Whittaker
item.description: The cybersecurity and automation giant said it's working with outside investigators to understand the scale of the breach.

item.title: All the questions Nvidia should answer on Tuesday — but probably won’t
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: Nvidia interim CEO and longtime CFO Colette Kress is about to have one of the biggest days of her career on Tuesday when the company reports its third-quarter results. Given the turmoil Nvidia is in, there are a number of questions that Nvidia should answer.

item.title: Apple reveals new Mac security controls as AI agents raise privacy risks
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Following an October announcement, Apple has detailed new permission controls, warnings, and transparency features coming to macOS 27.3 to address risks posed by AI agents and other apps.

item.title: California state AG sues OpenAI over rogue agent incidents
item.dc:creator: Russell Brandom
item.description: The California lawsuit represents one of the first attempts to hold an AI lab legally accountable for a rogue agent incident.
